hooks.text: 先采集资源建墙造塔抵挡怪潮，再主动离开防线反攻敌方据点
hooks.excerpt: Gather resources, build walls and towers, fight enemy waves, and push outward from your base to assault Hollowborn strongholds. Each mission starts fresh, challenging you to balance building, gathering, combat, upgrades, and boss fights before the pressure becomes too much.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 玩家亲自操控英雄参战，并从三种优势与打法不同的职业中选择
hooks.excerpt: Fight directly as the hero with class-based abilities Choose from 3 playable classes, each with distinct strengths and playstyles
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战役货币可跨任务解锁并强化能力、城墙、防御塔和高阶升级
hooks.excerpt: As you progress through the campaign, you’ll earn currencies used to unlock and enhance abilities, walls, towers, and powerful upgrades.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
